name: LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn is a professional network for member profiles, workplace relationships, company pages, jobs, and professional publishing. Relay's LinkedIn V1 is limited to the connected member's bounded OpenID profile, local text-only drafts, and intentional public text-only member posts.
agentUseSummary: Connect one LinkedIn member through Relay-owned OAuth with exact openid, profile, and w_member_social scopes so agents can read bounded profile fields, draft text locally, and publish one approved public text-only post. Email, profile pictures, social reads, comments, likes, media, organizations, messaging, enrichment, search, scraping, bulk automation, retries, pagination, and raw access are blocked.

credentialRequirements: Relay-owned LinkedIn OAuth client ID configured only on Railway
Relay-owned LinkedIn OAuth client secret retained only by Railway

capabilities.label: Read connected member
capabilities.description: Read bounded OpenID profile fields for the connected member.

capabilities.label: Draft text post
capabilities.description: Create a bounded text-only draft locally without a provider call.

capabilities.label: Publish text post
capabilities.description: Publish one public text-only post as the connected member after approval.

allowed.label: Get LinkedIn member profile
allowed.description: Read bounded OpenID profile fields for the connected member; email and picture are excluded.

allowed.label: Draft LinkedIn text post
allowed.description: Create one local text-only draft of at most 3,000 characters without calling LinkedIn.

approvalRequired.label: Publish LinkedIn text post
approvalRequired.description: Publish one public text-only post as the connected member after explicit approval.

blocked.label: Access email or enriched identity
blocked.description: Email, picture, identity verification, profile enrichment, other members, connections, invitations, and people search are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read or engage with social content
blocked.description: Feed/post reads, member social reads, comments, likes, reactions, and other engagement are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use broader LinkedIn products
blocked.description: Media, assets, documents, articles, reshares, polls, celebrations, mentions, organizations, analytics, ads, leads, and Learning are outside V1.

blocked.label: Message, search, or scrape
blocked.description: DMs, messaging, network search, scraping, browser automation, and unofficial endpoints are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad or raw access
blocked.description: Bulk or scheduled publishing, automatic retries or pagination, raw provider requests, RPC, GraphQL, and MCP surfaces are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded profile reads and local drafts run automatically; one connected-member public text post requires approval, while broader identity, social, media, organization, messaging, search, bulk, and raw surfaces remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three actions run without per-action approval; exact scopes, connected-member authorship, text-only body, 3,000-character limit, audit, and API controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Mounts exactly three bounded LinkedIn member profile, local draft, and approval-gated text-post wrapper tools.
Mounts exactly three bounded LinkedIn member profile, local draft, and approval-gated text-post wrapper tools.

providerSetup.blocker: A production Relay-owned LinkedIn application, exact Railway callback, OpenID Connect and Share on LinkedIn product access, exact scopes, one staging member, and provider acceptance remain pending outside this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure and review a Relay-owned LinkedIn app with only OpenID Connect and w_member_social, then validate one staging member, finite access-token expiry/reauthorization, and the three fixed wrappers through Railway.

evidence.supports: LinkedIn documents 3-legged authorization-code OAuth, least-scope consent, and approximately 60-day access-token lifetimes.
LinkedIn documents OpenID Connect scopes and the userinfo endpoint for bounded signed-in member fields.
LinkedIn documents the versioned Posts API, required Rest.li headers, w_member_social, text-only post creation, and x-restli-id response header.
LinkedIn documents programmatic refresh tokens as available to approved Marketing Developer Platform partners, so Relay self-serve V1 does not assume refresh support.
